params.q: What is the employee EPF contribution rate in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the employee EPF contribution rate in India?

response.markdown:
The standard employee EPF contribution rate in India is **12% of basic salary plus dearness allowance (DA)**, deducted each month and credited entirely to the employee's EPF account. [0] [1] [2] [3] [4] A reduced rate of **10%** applies only to certain specified establishments/industries under EPFO rules. [0] [3] [2]

For context, the employer also contributes 12%, split into 8.33% to the Employees' Pension Scheme (EPS, subject to the ₹15,000 pensionable wage ceiling) and 3.67% to EPF, plus 0.50% each for EDLI insurance and administrative charges. [3]

### References

0. [EPF Employee Contribution Rate Explained](https://www.shriramfinance.in/financial-faq-what-is-the-epf-contribution-rate-for-employees)
1. [PF Contribution Rate: Employee & Employer EPF Contribution Guide](https://savvyhrms.com/blog/pf-contribution-rate-how-much-do-employees-and-employers-contribute/)
2. [What is Employee Provident Fund & How Its Works](https://www.hdfc.bank.in/blogs/public-provident-fund/employee-provident-fund-what-is-the-eligibility)
3. [How to Calculate Your Employers EPF Contribution](https://www.bajajfinserv.in/investments/how-to-calculate-your-employers-epf-contribution)
4. [Employees' Provident Fund 2025 - EPF Interest Rate, Passbook, Login](https://www.paisabazaar.com/saving-schemes/epf/)
